machines.address.title: Where is the printer?
machines.address.label: Address
machines.address.help: A host name or IP address, with a port if it is not 7125. A URL works too.
machines.address.invalid: Enter a host, host:port or a URL.
machines.details.title: Name the printer
machines.name.label: Name
machines.name.help: Lower case letters, digits and dashes.
machines.name.invalid: Use lower case letters, digits and dashes, up to 63 characters.
machines.unit.label: Identity
machines.unit.help: Identifies the printer if its address changes. Defaults to the name.
machines.model.label: Model
machines.model.help: Optional. Klipper reports no model, so the host name shows when this is empty.
machines.vendor.label: Vendor
machines.vendor.help: Optional. Shown as Klipper when empty.
machines.apiKey.label: API key
machines.apiKey.help: Only for a Moonraker that requires authorization. Sent as the X-Api-Key header.

machines.waiting.lead: Added {name}. Waiting for the printer to answer.
machines.waiting.slow.title: It has not connected yet
machines.waiting.slow.body: Check that Moonraker answers at {address}, and that the server configuration has a connector named {connector} with type moonraker. A Moonraker that requires authorization needs its API key under Advanced.
